challenges.description: Decode this message: 'synt{ebg13_vf_rnfl}'. It's a simple substitution cipher.

challenges.hint: Each 8-bit sequence represents one ASCII character.

challenges.hint: Convert decimal ASCII values to their corresponding characters.

challenges.description: XOR each character of 'EKCI' with the key '5' (ASCII 53). The result is your flag format.
challenges.hint: XOR each byte with 53. Apply that operation to the supplied text, then read the resulting flag.
challenges.title: Daily #8: XOR Simple

challenges.description: Decrypt this Atbash cipher: 'uozt{zgyzhs_rksvih}'. A becomes Z, B becomes Y, etc.
challenges.hint: Atbash reverses the alphabet: A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X, etc.
challenges.title: Daily #9: Atbash Cipher

challenges.hint: Replace numbers with letters: 4=a, 3=e, 7=t, 1=i, 5=s, 0=o
challenges.title: Daily #10: Leetspeak

challenges.hint: Use an online Brainfuck interpreter to execute this code.
challenges.title: Daily #11: Brainfuck Intro

challenges.hint: In Pig Latin, the first consonant moves to the end and 'ay' is added.

source.scope: Self-contained daily encoding and cipher CTF warmups. No network targets or executable assets are included.
source.training_note: Published CTF exercise data is kept outside operational evidence and is not represented as real incident telemetry.
transformations: The upstream XOR warmup hint repeats its full answer; the public practice hint is rewritten to describe the method without disclosing the flag. The original CSV remains preserved for provenance.
